dataset_version: official EULA-controlled release; archive version to be recorded at acquisition
dataset_role: prospectively reserved one-shot external confirmation of frozen DCS-OPCT v11
scientific_scope: cross-dataset, cross-device, and cross-channel-count confirmation on independently collected 14-channel wearable EEG during shared affective short-video stimuli

allowed_before_registration: original publication and official public dataset description
aggregate cohort size, channel count, sensor identity, stimulus count, and published stimulus design
file names, archive byte sizes, checksums, and schemas after authorized acquisition but before participant values are parsed
not_accessed_before_registration: AMIGOS participant rows or participant-level metadata values
EEG samples or derived participant features
AMIGOS risk probabilities, calibration actions, certificates, or held-out results

source.publication: Miranda-Correa et al., IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing, 2018, doi:10.1109/TAFFC.2018.2884461
source.access_condition: authorized download under the dataset EULA; no credential handling by the analysis code
source.expected_public_scale: 40 participants, 16 shared short videos, 14-channel Emotiv EPOC EEG in the individual-viewing branch

cohort_contract.branch: individual viewing of the 16 short videos only
cohort_contract.exclusions: only unreadable files, absent registered EEG channels, missing physical-video identifiers, missing required trial intervals, nonfinite signal, or fewer than three valid analysis windows; no exclusion based on labels, risk scores, calibration outcomes, identity decodability, or classifier performance
cohort_contract.hard_failure: stop before model fitting if fewer than 30 participants have all 16 physical short-video trials and the complete registered montage

tasks: published expected-valence quadrant: high versus low
published expected-arousal quadrant: high versus low
task_contract.label_source: the fixed published short-video quadrant assignment, not participant self-report
task_contract.class_balance: eight high and eight low physical videos per task
task_contract.forbidden_relabeling: no participant response, sample prevalence, model prediction, or performance-dependent thresholding
task_contract.claim_boundary: stimulus-quadrant tasks test protocol transfer and are not equivalent to experienced-emotion self-report labels

trial_contract.stimulus_identity: the official short-video index shared across participants
trial_contract.stimulus_role: crossed held-out factor only; no separate confirmatory stimulus-axis endpoint
trial_contract.pseudoreplication_rule: one aggregate feature vector per participant-video pair; windows and repeated samples may not be treated as independent trials

feature_contract.construction: common-average reference, four-second windows with two-second step, linear detrending, Welch PSD, fixed band integration, and mean/population-SD/least-squares-slope summaries as in the frozen FACED implementation

dcs_opct_v11_contract.one_shot_rule: the registered assignment and gate are the only confirmatory analysis; later cohort, task, seed, order, or feature variants are exploratory

acceptance_gate.endpoint_eligibility: both audit and held-out partitions contain at least one material event and one non-event; otherwise discrimination and calibration effectiveness are non-estimable
acceptance_gate.effectiveness: a non-identity action is applicable, independently certified, and has held-out Brier gain greater than 0.001
acceptance_gate.released_action_nonharm: held-out Brier gain is nonnegative, held-out AUROC delta is at least -0.02, rank is at least 0.999999, and order inversions equal zero
acceptance_gate.strong_claim: prospective external effective-and-safe confirmation is available only if endpoint eligibility, effectiveness, and every released-action non-harm item pass
acceptance_gate.identity_fallback: identity is non-intervention and is not evidence of effectiveness or safety success
acceptance_gate.failure_policy: all acquisition, structural, construction, endpoint-eligibility, applicability, certification, effectiveness, and non-harm failures remain reportable and immutable

execution_order: validate this reservation and the unchanged v11 freeze
receive the authorized archive without exposing credentials to analysis code
write and hash a schema-only acquisition manifest before parsing participant values
implement, test on synthetic schema fixtures, and hash all analysis code
parse participant, trial, label, and EEG values once
run the registered feature construction and counterfactual experiment once
write and hash the unlabeled action and audit assignment before attaching material-event outcomes
apply frozen DCS-OPCT v11 once and write the primary gate before sensitivity analysis
claim_boundary: This reservation authorizes a future one-shot AMIGOS evaluation. It does not assert archive availability, structural eligibility, endpoint variation, applicability, effectiveness, non-harm, safety, or physiological materiality.
